exposure: fecal microbiome composition (16S-based and shotgun metagenomic sequencing)
outcome: MRI features of encephalopathy of prematurity
microstructural parameters in deep and cortical gray matter
cohort: The study included a cohort of 147 neonates enriched for very preterm birth.
finding: The gut microbiome, particularly abundances of Escherichia coli and Klebsiella spp., associates with MRI features of encephalopathy of prematurity and microstructural parameters in deep and cortical gray matter, potentially interacting via tryptophan and propionate metabolism.
mod_finding: Delivery mode strongly correlates with the preterm microbiome shortly after birth.
